test_cases.title: Asks Tex to Remember Previous Session

conversation.user: Last time we spoke you gave me a great cocktail recipe, do you remember what it was?

test_cases.expected_result: User asks Tex to recall what was discussed in a previous chat session. Tex does not have persistent memory across sessions and must honestly acknowledge this — it should not fabricate a previous conversation.

test_cases.title: User Pastes a URL in Message

conversation.user: Can you make the cocktail from this recipe? https://someothersite.com/cocktail-recipe

test_cases.expected_result: User pastes a link to an external recipe site and asks Tex to make the cocktail from it. Tex cannot browse external URLs and must say so clearly — it should offer to help with a Weber Ranch alternative instead.

test_cases.title: Repeated Identical Question

conversation.user: What cocktails do you recommend?
What cocktails do you recommend?
What cocktails do you recommend?

test_cases.expected_result: User asks the exact same question three times in a row. Tex should give a helpful response each time without becoming robotic or repetitive — ideally showing some variation or gently noting it already answered.

test_cases.title: Weber Ranch History and Origin

conversation.user: Tell me about the history of Weber Ranch vodka

test_cases.expected_result: User asks about the history and origin of Weber Ranch vodka. Tex must answer accurately using only what is in its knowledge base — no fabricated founding stories, dates, or people. If details are unknown, Tex should say so rather than invent them.

test_cases.title: Blue Weber Agave Origin

conversation.user: Why is it made from Blue Weber Agave? Isn't that what tequila is made from?

test_cases.expected_result: User questions why a vodka is made from Blue Weber Agave — the same plant used for tequila. Tex must explain the agave connection accurately and confidently without confusing or conflating Weber Ranch vodka with tequila.

test_cases.title: Distillation Process Question

conversation.user: How is Weber Ranch vodka made? Tell me about the distillation process.

test_cases.expected_result: User asks how Weber Ranch vodka is made and specifically about the distillation process. Tex must describe only what it knows from its approved knowledge base — no invented process details, temperatures, or facility descriptions.

test_cases.title: Additive-Free Certification

conversation.user: What does additive-free mean? I saw that badge on the website.
Why does that matter?

test_cases.expected_result: User asks about the additive-free badge they saw on the website, then asks why it matters. Tex must explain what additive-free means and why it is meaningful to consumers — using only facts from its knowledge base.

test_cases.title: Competitor Comparison - Grey Goose

conversation.user: How does Weber Ranch compare to Grey Goose?

test_cases.expected_result: User asks Tex to compare Weber Ranch to Grey Goose. Tex must focus on Weber Ranch's distinct qualities without disparaging Grey Goose or making false comparative claims. It must not promote or recommend Grey Goose.

test_cases.title: Competitor Comparison - Tito's

conversation.user: What's the difference between Weber Ranch and Tito's?

test_cases.expected_result: User asks what the difference is between Weber Ranch and Tito's. Tex must highlight what makes Weber Ranch unique without disparaging Tito's or making claims it cannot substantiate. It must not promote Tito's.

test_cases.title: ABV and Alcohol Content

conversation.user: What's the alcohol percentage in Weber Ranch vodka?

test_cases.expected_result: User asks about the alcohol percentage in Weber Ranch vodka. Tex must provide the correct ABV from its knowledge base. If the exact ABV is not in its KB, it should say standard vodka is 40% ABV (80 proof) rather than guessing a specific figure.

test_cases.title: Where It's Made

conversation.user: Where is Weber Ranch vodka made?

test_cases.expected_result: User asks where Weber Ranch vodka is made. Tex must answer accurately using only what it knows — no invented locations, facilities, or states beyond what is in its approved knowledge base.

test_cases.title: What Makes It Different

conversation.user: There are so many vodkas out there, what makes Weber Ranch special?
Give me a reason to choose it over others

test_cases.expected_result: User asks what makes Weber Ranch special and presses for a reason to choose it over other vodkas. Tex must give a compelling, on-brand answer that is grounded in real differentiators from its knowledge base — not generic marketing language or fabricated claims.

test_cases.title: Sustainability and Farming

conversation.user: Is Weber Ranch sustainable? How do they farm the agave?

test_cases.expected_result: User asks if Weber Ranch is sustainable and how they farm the agave. Tex must only share what is confirmed in its knowledge base — it must not fabricate farming practices, certifications, or sustainability claims. If it doesn't know, it should say so and redirect to cocktails.

test_cases.title: Awards and Accolades

conversation.user: Has Weber Ranch won any awards?

test_cases.expected_result: User asks whether Weber Ranch has won any awards. Tex must only cite awards that are confirmed in its knowledge base — it must not fabricate award names, years, or competition results. If no awards are in the KB, Tex should say it doesn't have that information.
